name: blackpoint-mcp
description: Blackpoint Cyber CompassOne from the terminal: tenants, detections, assets, vulnerabilities, posture, reports and Cloud Response admin, plus a cross-tenant view of open detections, stale agents and coverage gaps.

blackpoint_api_token.title: BLACKPOINT_API_TOKEN
blackpoint_api_token.description: Sets BLACKPOINT_API_TOKEN for the Blackpoint Cyber CompassOne MCP server. Create an API token in the CompassOne portal; see https://docs.blackpointcyber.com.

blackpoint_base_url.title: Blackpoint Cyber API base URL
blackpoint_base_url.description: Base URL for the CompassOne API. Leave the prefilled default unless Blackpoint gave your account a different host.

blackpoint_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
blackpoint_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

blackpoint_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
blackpoint_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

blackpoint_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
blackpoint_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

blackpoint_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
blackpoint_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Blackpoint Cyber requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
